hypothesis: The v1 opening-hand failure is caused by the combined 20-land and 27-one-mana distribution. Raising the deck to 22 lands and reducing it to twelve turn-one threat copies plus three one-mana burn spells, while preserving six repeatable spell-damage creatures and moving the remaining slots into explicit reload and two- or three-mana burn, will restore the predeclared benchmark and plan-capable gates without giving up the Pioneer-derived opening pattern.

keep: Two or three lands plus one of the twelve turn-one threats and either a repeatable spell-damage creature or direct burn.
One land only with at least two castable one-mana cards and no hand that depends on resolving a three-mana spell.
Four lands only with a turn-one threat and explicit reload.
mulligan: Zero lands or five or more lands.
A hand without a turn-one threat, direct burn, or a credible turn-two engine.
A one-land hand containing Call In a Professional, Fateful End, or Flick a Coin without sufficient early action.
Ramunap Ruins as the only land when repeated red activation would require accepting avoidable life loss.

white_tokens.notes: Pyroclasm is symmetrical and should be cast before rebuilding. Smash to Dust is strongest against artifact tokens or one-toughness boards and is not treated as a universal sweeper.

artifacts.notes: Retain Abrade. Select the actual relevant mode of Smash to Dust rather than counting every mode simultaneously.

spell_heavy.notes: Magebane Lizard triggers for both players and punishes additional noncreature spells only after the relevant spells are cast.

lifegain.notes: Giant Cindermaw prevents opponents from gaining life only while it remains on the battlefield and does not provide immediate entry damage.

graveyard_or_library_cheat.notes: Runestone does not stop cards entering from hand or exile and contributes no direct pressure.
